intentionalSkip: The two-column mobile-only layout assertion is skipped in the desktop project; it passes in the mobile project.
coverage: Initial HTML without JavaScript: company, categories, catalog and solution pages
Missing media does not block text or category links
Catalog URL search, submit, clear, back/forward navigation and mobile two-column descriptions
Hero video playback, timeline progress, slide controls and media ended transition
Reduced motion, company video visibility and desktop category tilt
Seven-step demo form: required fields, phone country selector, email validation, previous step, optional attachment, consent, progress only on advance, success and Escape
Cooling selections and all five FireOff camera/detail mappings, annotations and catalog links
HTTP 503, corrupt GLB and unavailable WebGL for all three scenes; retries clear cached failures
Cooling context loss/recreation preserves accessible description selection
Direct route smoke: page errors, hydration errors and unexpected local 404 responses
Catalog video paths, looping, playback readiness and visibility pause under root and prefixed deployment
Large product banners make no image request before their viewport, render after scrolling, and remain visible with JavaScript disabled
Failed viewer JavaScript chunks for all three scenes; accessible description selection before retry; new chunk request without document reload, including the selected mobile designer product

explicitExceptions.externalMap: Yandex map iframe is replaced by a local HTML fixture in route smoke; the external provider is not part of these tests.
explicitExceptions.submission: The form success check verifies the demo UI only. No real request delivery is connected or claimed.
explicitExceptions.renderer: SwiftShader may be used by Chrome. These are correctness tests, not FPS or device-performance measurements.

productIssuesFoundAndFixed: Route-level loading streamed content into a hidden boundary without JavaScript.
Mobile designer product buttons lost accessible names when CSS hid their title.
Mobile designer selected-product panel covered the failed-viewer retry button; recovery now occupies its own flow outlet.
testIssuesFixed: Explicit no-preference in autoplay tests, since default config is reduced motion.
Root catalog uses an accessible main label instead of an h1 in the existing design.
Bounded retry for a scroll action while React replaces a streaming shell.

finalFollowup.reason: Full final suites after corrected semibold fallback metrics, retryable viewer imports and designer recovery layout
